bar.name: December's quality bar
bar.passes: the row's paired nDCG@10 delta against hybrid@bge-small has a 95% interval whose lower end is above zero on fixture v1's held-out questions AND on BEIR SciFact AND on BEIR FiQA
bar.applies_to: every reranked row: the candidates, the students, bge-reranker-v2-m3 and the teacher
bar.interval: percentile bootstrap over the queries, paired, 2000 resamples, seed 0 (app/eval/stats.py)
bar.held_out: fixture v1: the test half of app.eval.rerank_arms.split_questions (alternate inside each category, gold order), as make bench-rrf-sweep uses it; no choice is made on the other (tune) half; BEIR: the test split
bar.also_reported: each row's delta against bge-reranker-v2-m3 and against the teacher; a student's against the candidate it started from
bar.not_decided_here: the serving bar: added p95 latency and peak memory at the served depth, measured on the host itself; a CPU timing from another machine is indicative only

small_rerankers.load_and_score: every model first ranks the check's answer above an unrelated passage with the loaded instance, or the run stops (app/eval/models_2026.py)

reproduces.compared: every field of each row's retrieval block (rounded means; by category on the fixture), [committed, this run] where they differ
